summary.text: Greg Costantino is a Democratic state representative from District 44 who took office on January 1, 2013 and is seeking re-election; he advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as vice president of Venda Ravioli and real estate developer.

paragraphs.text: Costantino's professional experience includes working as vice president of operations for Venda Ravioli in Providence, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia also lists him as an independent candidate for District 44 in the 2010 general election.
